details.further_information: Parents from DR Congo. SC Braga sold 80% of the player's economic rights to Al-Jazira for €9.5 million - €8.5 million as a fixed fee and €1 million contingent on collective and individual performance goals. Braga retains the remaining 20% of the player's economic rights as a sell-on clause.
